Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:10:1.english: Like the dormus - A great and large market.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:11:1.hebrew: באכלבי וארבי - משיתחילו בעלי בתים ואוצרי פירות לפתוח אוצרותיהם, וספינות באות בנהר המביאות תבואה למכור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:11:1.english: [Wheat] of storehouses and ships - From when householders and those who store produce begin to open their storehouses, and ships come on the river bringing grain to sell.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:11:2.english: As their rate lasts - for a long time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:12:1.hebrew: אין פוסקין על חדשות מארבע עד שיצא שער לחדש ולישן - דהא דחדשים מארבע, משום דלא יבשו עדיין כל הצורך, והפוסק על החדשות לא יקבלם הימנו עכשיו, אלא לאחר זמן כשיתייבשו כל צרכם. לפיכך, אין פוסק עליהם לקבל עליהן ארבע סאין בסלע עד שיצא השער בארבע לחדש ולישן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:12:1.english: One may not set [a price] for new [grain] at four [se'ah per sela] until a market rate is publicized for the new and for the old - For the reason that new [grain] is [priced] at four [is] because it has not yet dried sufficiently, and one who sets a price for the new [grain] will not receive it from him now, but rather after some time, when it will have dried sufficiently. Therefore, he may not set [a price] for it to receive four se'ah for a sela until the market rate is publicized at four for both new and old.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:13:1.hebrew: היו של לקוטות מארבע - סתם תבואות לקוטות אינן יפין, שלוקטין בכמה שדות ומערבין שיבלי שיפון עם שיבלי חטין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:13:1.english: [If] those of gleaners were [selling] at four - Ordinarily, gleaners' produce is not of good [quality], because they glean in several fields and mix ears of rye with ears of wheat.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:13:2.hebrew: אין פוסקין עם בעל הבית מארבע - עד שיצא השער של ד' ללוקט ולמוכר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:13:2.english: One may not set a price with the homeowner at four [se'ah per sela] - until the market rate of four goes out for [both] the gleaner and the seller.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:14:1.english: He can borrow from a gleaner - Mixed grain.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:15:1.hebrew: אין לוין על שער שבשוק - אני שמעתי: אין לוין מעות בדרך הלואה ע"מ שאם לא אשלם לך מעות עד זמן פלוני, אתן לך פירות כשער של עכשיו, דאע"ג דדרך מקח וממכר שרי, דרך הלואה אסור. ובהלכות גדולות מפרש: אין לוין סאה בסאה על סמך שער שבשוק, דנימא הואיל וחיטי בהיני וחיטי בשילי הוה ליה כעד שיבא בני או עד שאמצא מפתח (לקמן בבא מציעא דף עה.):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:15:1.english: One may not borrow based on the market rate - I have heard [that this means]: One may not borrow money as a loan on the condition that if I do not pay you money by a certain time, I will give you produce at the current rate; for even though [such an arrangement] is permitted by way of buying and selling, by way of a loan it is forbidden. And in Halakhot Gedolot it explains [this as follows]: One may not borrow a se'ah for a se'ah relying on the market rate, such that we would say that since there is wheat in Hini and wheat in Shili, it is like [the case of] "until my son comes" or "until I find the key" (below, Bava Metzia 75a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:15:2.english: Who borrow in Tishrei - [They borrow] money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:15:3.hebrew: ופרעי פירות בטבת - כשער של תשרי. וללשון האחר, לוין חטין ופורעין חטין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:15:3.english: And pay [with] produce in Tevet - At the [market] rate of Tishrei. And according to the other version, they borrow wheat and pay [back] wheat.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:17:1.english: From [one] place to [another] place - From an inexpensive place to an expensive place.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:17:2.english: Give it to me - And I will transport it and use the money for my needs until a certain time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:1:1.hebrew: מודה בשטר שכתבו - מאחר שהלוה מודה ששטר חוב שהוציא עליו שטר אמת הוא, אין המלוה צריך לחזר אחר העדים החתומין בו ולהעיד על חתימתן ולקיימו. וה"נ, הרי מודה שמכרו לו באחריות, ואם השטר בטל לענין המכירה מפני שטר המתנה שקדמו, לא בטיל לענין אחריות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:1:1.english: [One who] admits regarding a document that he wrote it - Since the borrower admits that the promissory note that [the lender] produced against him is an authentic document, the lender does not need to search for the witnesses signed on it [to have them] testify regarding their signatures and ratify it. So too here: behold, he admits that he sold [it] to him with a guarantee, and [even] if the document is void with respect to the sale because of the gift document that preceded it, it is not void with respect to the guarantee.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:2:1.hebrew: לא ניתן ליכתב - מאחר שנתנו כבר במתנה, ועל כרחו כתבו ליה זה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:2:1.english: It may not be written - Since he had already given it as a gift, and against his will they wrote this [document] for him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:3:2.english: Let us say it may not be written - Rather, infer from this [that] a document is not voided because of this reason.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:1.hebrew: לשבח קרקעות כיצד - רישא דידיה: "אין מוציאין לאכילת פירות ולשבח קרקעות מנכסי' משועבדים מפני תקון העולם", וקא מפרש "לשבח קרקעות כיצד":
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:1.english: What [is the case of] for the enhancement of land - Its first clause [states]: "One does not exact [payment] for the consumption of produce or for the enhancement of land from liened property, for the betterment of the world," and [the baraita] explains: "What [is the case of] for the enhancement of land?"

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:2.hebrew: והרי היא יוצאה מתחת ידו - של לוקח, שהנגזל מוציאה בדין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:2.english: And behold, it goes out from his possession - [that] of the buyer, for the robbed party extracts it in court.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:3.english: When he collects - When the buyer collects money from the robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:4.hebrew: מנכסים משועבדים - טורף לקוחות שלקחו אחריו, מפני שהאחריות שכתב בשטר מכירתו קודם למקחו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:4.english: From liened property - [He] seizes [property from] buyers who purchased [from the robber] after him, because the guarantee that [the robber] wrote in his deed of sale precedes their purchase.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:5.hebrew: ושבח מנכסים בני חורין - ולא ממשועבדים, מפני תקון העולם, דאין הלקוחות יכולין להזהר בדבר שאין לו קצבה, כגון אחריות השבח והפירות. דבשלמא בקרן נזהרין להניח מקום לגבות ממנו, ואי לא נזהרו — אפסידו אנפשייהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:5.english: And [he collects] the enhancement from unsold property - And not from liened [property], for the betterment of the world, because purchasers cannot take precautions regarding something that has no fixed limit, such as the guarantee of the enhancement and the produce. For granted, regarding the principal, they take precautions to leave [unsold property] from which to collect, and if they did not take precautions, they brought the loss upon themselves.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:6.hebrew: נימא לא ניתן - שטר מכירה זה ליכתב, שהרי גזולה היתה, ובטל השטר ואחריות שבו, ואמאי גובה קרן מנכסי' משועבדים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:4:6.english: Let us say it was not permitted - [for] this deed of sale to be written, since [the field] was stolen, and [thus] the deed and the guarantee [written] in it are void; so why does he collect the principal from liened property?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:1.hebrew: אי למ"ד - בפ"ק [דף טו:]:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:1.english: Either according to the one who says - In the first chapter [15b].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:2.hebrew: ניחא ליה דלא ליקרייה גזלנא - אדם שמכר שדה גזולה לחבירו, מחזר על הבעלים הראשונים ולוקחה מהם להעמיד ביד הלוקח, כי היכי דלא ליקרייה גזלנא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:2.english: It is preferable for him not to be called a robber - A person who sold a stolen field to his fellow seeks out the original owners and buys it from them to establish [it] in the hand of the buyer, so that he will not be called a robber.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:3.english: He appeases its owner - [He] purchases it from the original owners.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:4.english: Here he is hiding [it] from him - For he transferred [the property] to his minor son in order to hide [it] from this [buyer].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:5.hebrew: שטריה מקיים ליה - בתמיה. אין דעתו להחזיקה בידו, הלכך לא ניתן ליכתב הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:5:5.english: [Will he] ratify his document - [This is said] rhetorically! His intention is not to keep [the field] in [the buyer's] possession; therefore, it is not [a document] meant to be written.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:1.hebrew: היה הוא תחילה לקוצרים - ויש לו גדיש, ועדיין לא יצא השער:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:1.english: [If] he was first among the reapers - And he has a stack [of grain], and the market price has not yet been set.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:2.hebrew: פוסק עמו - באיזה שער שירצה לתת לו מאותו גדיש, דכיון דיש לו, אין כאן רבית, דמעכשיו הוא קנוי לו, ואע"פ שלא משך. דכי אין לו נמי אבק רבית מדרבנן הוא, וכי יש לו לא גזור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:2.english: He may set [a price] with him - At whatever rate he wishes, to give him from that stack [of grain]; for since he has [it in his possession], there is no [prohibition of] interest here, as it is acquired by [the buyer] from now, even though he has not [yet] performed *meshikhah* [taking possession]. For even when he does not have [it], [such a transaction] is [only] *avak ribbit* [a secondary form of interest] by rabbinic law, and where he [already] has [it], [the Rabbis] did not decree [a prohibition].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:3.hebrew: על העביט של ענבים - כלי גדול שצוברין בו את הענבים לפני דריכה, והם מתחממין ומתבשלים להוציא יינם יפה יפה. ושל זיתים קרוי מעטן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:3.english: For the basket [avit] of grapes - A large vessel in which they pile up the grapes before treading, and they heat up and ripen to yield their wine thoroughly. And [that] of olives is called a ma'atan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:4.hebrew: ועל הביצים של יוצר - פוסק עם היוצר על הקדירות באיזו שער שירצה, ואע"פ שלא יצא השער, אם הכניס עפר ועשאו ביצים שקורין מעונט"ש ועושה מהם קדירות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:4.english: Or for the clumps [of clay] of a potter - He may set a price with the potter for the pots at whatever rate he wishes, even though the [market] rate has not yet been established, if he has [already] brought in clay and made it into lumps, which are called monts [in Old French], and makes pots from them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:5.hebrew: ועל הסיד - פוסק עמו משישקענו בכבשן, אבנים והעצים לשרוף:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:7:5.english: And for the lime - He may set [a price] with him once he sinks it in the kiln, [i.e., the] stones and the wood to burn.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:8:1.hebrew: <abbr title="הכי גרסינן">ה"ג</abbr> רבי יוסי אומר: לעולם אינו פוסק עמו על הזבל, עד שיהא לו זבל באשפות:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:8:1.english: This is the reading: Rabbi Yosei says: One may never set [a price] with him for manure until he has manure in the dunghills.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:9:1.hebrew: ופוסק עמו כשער הגבוה - אם יפחות השער ממה שהוא עכשיו, תתן לי כשער הזול. שער הגבוה היינו בזול, שנותנין פירות הרבה בדמים מועטים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:9:1.english: And one may set [a price] with him at the highest rate - If the market rate drops below what it is now, you shall give me [produce] at the cheap rate. "The highest rate" means cheap, where they give much produce for little money.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:9:2.english: He may say to him - when he sees the cheaper rate.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:9:3.hebrew: תן לי כזה או תן לי מעותי - שהרי לא משך, ויכול לחזור בו, ואפילו מי שפרע ליכא, הואיל ולא נתן מעותיו ע"מ לקבל עכשיו אלא לאחר זמן, ובתוך כך נשתנה השער. סתם דעתיה דאיניש אתרעא זולא פסיק:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 72b:9:3.english: Give me [at] this [rate] or give me my money - For he has not [yet] drawn [the produce into his possession], so he can retract, and there is not even [the censure of] mi shepara ["He who exacted punishment"], since he did not give his money in order to receive [the produce] immediately, but rather after some time, and in the meantime the market rate changed. Ordinarily, a person's mind is set on the cheaper rate.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:14:1.hebrew: יזיף מלקוט חבריה - אי לאו משום דמצי למיזף, אע"ג דמצי למזבן, אין חשוב שער לפסוק עליו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:14:1.english: He borrows from another gleaner - If not for the fact that he can borrow, even though he can buy, it is not considered a market rate upon which to set a price:

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:15:1.hebrew: אין לוין על שער שבשוק - ומסקנא דלוין, לפי ה"ג דאיירי סאה בסאה, מיירי ביש לו מעות ללוה דמצי זבין בשוקא, או יש לו מעט, כדרבי יצחק בסוף פירקא (דף עה.): "יש לו סאה — לוה עליה כמה כורים". וק"ק: למה לי שער? רק שימצא פירות לקנות אפילו ביוקר. ואית דגרסינן: "אין לוין על פירות שבשוק":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:15:1.english: One may not borrow based on the market rate - And the conclusion [of the Gemara], that one may borrow, according to Halakhot Gedolot, which [explains that the Gemara] is speaking of [borrowing] a se'ah for a se'ah, refers to a case where the borrower has money so that he can buy [produce] in the market, or he has a small amount [of produce], in accordance with [the statement of] Rabbi Yitzḥak at the end of the chapter (75a): "[If] he has a se'ah, he may borrow several kors against it." And it is somewhat difficult: Why do I need [an established] market rate? [It should suffice] merely that produce can be found to buy, even at a high price. And there are those who have the reading: "One may not borrow on the produce that is in the market."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:9:1.hebrew: יכול לומר לו תן לי כזה או תן לי מעותי - אין זה מעמיד מלוה על גבי פירות, כיון דבתורת מקח נותן לו מעות תחילה; ואפילו מי שפרע ליכא, דדעתייהו דאינשי אתרעא זילא כשנותן מעות על מנת לקבל פירות לאחר זמן:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 72b:9:1.english: He may say to him: Give me [produce] at this [rate] or give me my money - This is not [a case of] establishing a loan upon produce, since he gives him the money initially as a purchase; and there is not even [the curse of] mi shepara ["He who exacted punishment"], because people's intention is for the lower price when one gives money in order to receive produce after a period of time.
